reviews.text:
I came from another clinic where they told me my dog ​​was fine.
I went there because of the positive reviews I saw, and they immediately saw that my little dog had leishmaniasis. 😔
I'm so happy and grateful to have found them.
They are both lovely and, above all, professional. They treat Odi wonderfully, and I'm sure my dog ​​will pull through. 🙏
Thank you so much! ❤️
As a family doctor, they are very kind and affordable, and provide good service.

Highly recommended veterinary clinic! We were very pleased with the service, both for ourselves and our cat. They explain everything in detail and are very attentive. Even though our kitten is a bit of a handful, they were very patient and dedicated.
Highly recommended, and thank you for helping us with our little whirlwind! 💪🏽🐱

Very attentive and considerate. I had to go without an appointment due to an emergency on a Friday afternoon, and they were able to see me. They were very good with cats, even though I didn't know their temperament. They were able to perform the necessary diagnostic tests. Thank you ❤️, I hope I don't have to return anytime soon.
Very friendly and responsible, my dog ​​loves them 😻 …
They are great professionals and the way they treat our dog is wonderful.
They are delightful. They attend to you, explain things to you, and pamper our pets as if they were their own.

I absolutely do not recommend this clinic. They gave my dog ​​the wrong treatment without running any tests for a week, and she showed no improvement. My dog ​​is currently undergoing emergency surgery elsewhere. If you care about your animals, don't take them here. It's appalling.
Terrible service. My dog ​​almost died from an infection. We had to take her to another vet for emergency surgery. She barely survived. I absolutely do not recommend them.

Very professional and dedicated to animals.
I was seen the same day 🤗🤗🤗 …
Fantastic clinic, I take my dog ​​there whenever he needs it.
Wonderful! My cat was super calm, whereas at other vets he never calmed down. They provided lots of information about everything they were doing and gave great recommendations!

Maria is a wonderful person with animals; she's very competent and it's clear she loves her work. My kittens don't get stressed with her and her wonderful assistant, and I feel very safe taking them to that clinic.
Excellent service and treatment. Very professional, I highly recommend them.
They take great care of Suchard, always with love and a smile ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
Excellent service from Maria the veterinarian. Reasonable prices and very good service.
Excellent staff
I'm delighted with Maria; she's a fantastic veterinarian, always so kind. You can tell she loves her job. I wouldn't trade her for anything! 😜 And her assistant, Silvia, is wonderful too. …
The best 🫶🏻 …
The best place to take your pet. Maria is the best. Always available, and the truth is, the treatment of both owner and pet is unbeatable. 100% recommended.
Excellent service and professional staff. I always go there.

I'm very happy with Mari Carmen (very professional) and her assistant (super patient and caring). They're not interested in taking your money at all; they simply do their job well and honestly. They have an app where you can keep track of all the vaccinations and deworming treatments. Very pleased. Affordable prices.
Very kind and helpful, they post kittens for adoption, taking great care of them.
Super!! Excellent service

Everything went well. I brought my cat. She's usually afraid of strangers, but the doctor found a way to talk to her and my Margo sat calmly, which really surprised me. The cat was cured and she felt better that same day.
Very friendly and super professional. And even though it was just minutes before closing time and we weren't yet customers, they served us right away. Thank you!
